Elise — thanks, and welcome. I've started a vendor master ticket; to complete registration we need the items below. I attached our standard Vendor Onboarding Form in case you prefer to fill that instead of sending separate docs.

Required to create master record and enable PO routing (minimum):
1) Legal entity name (as registered) and DBA if applicable
2) Tax ID/EIN and tax classification (US-only: W-9 completed)
3) Registered address and billing address (if different)
4) AP contact name, email, phone
5) Bank remittance instructions for ACH or wire (routing/account masked okay)
6) Preferred invoice submission method and PO acceptance email (does AP accept PO-less invoices?)
7) Remit-to email for e-invoicing or vendor portal
8) Beneficial owner / UBO declaration (if not part of the W-9 packet)
9) Good-faith estimate of expected monthly volume so we can set initial payment limits and PO thresholds

Operational notes and optional items:
- If you require specific PO prefixing or a special invoice line for tax recovery, include that.
- For EMEA shipments we have a different PO channel; if you plan to invoice from UK/EU entity, please provide that legal entity and VAT registration.

Attachments: Redwood_Vendor_Onboarding_Form.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Next steps: Please return the form or the items above. Once we have the docs we can provision a vendor code and share the PO prefix and payment terms. Marissa, can you confirm standard onboarding timeline for a US-incorporated supplier?

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
